title: schnorr::build_signable truncates dst_addr_len byte for dst_addr longer than 255 bytes
description: rust/lichen-link/src/schnorr.rs build_signable() does buf.push(dst_addr.len() as u8) with no range validation. sign_frame/verify_frame are public API taking arbitrary slices; a >255-byte dst_addr would encode a truncated DST_LEN while appending all address bytes, producing signed data that no conforming frame can reproduce and enabling TX/RX disagreement. Not reachable through LinkLayer::build_frame/receive_frame (AddrMode bounds addr len at 8 and rx_frame_length now validates), so latent public-API hazard only. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3.2; suggest validating dst_addr.len() <= 255 or returning an error from sign_frame/verify_frame.
